George Purnell Gunn

ChurchEpiscopal Church
DioceseSouthern Virginia
In office1903-1971

George Purnell Gunn (October 11, 1903, June 16, 1973) was an American prelate who served as the ninth Episcopal Bishop of Southern Virginia between 1950 and 1971. Gunn was born on October 11, 1903, in Winona, Mississippi, the son of Rev. Elijah Sterling Gunn and Susan Ellwood Carter. He became active with the First Families of Virginia, raised in Halifax County, Virginia.
